definitions.gloss: traditional coffee shop; old-style cafe (serving only coffee and light food, no alcohol)
definitions.explanation: A type of Japanese coffee shop from the Showa era that serves only non-alcoholic beverages and light meals. Distinguished from bars or cafes that serve alcohol. Many feature retro decor and a quiet atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{純喫茶|じゅんきっさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧レトロな⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: That traditional coffee shop has a nice retro atmosphere.

notes:
A culturally significant Japanese concept. The ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧ (pure) in the name distinguishes these establishments from ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧ that also served alcohol — a distinction that mattered during the mid-20th century when licensing differed. Today, {純喫茶|じゅんきっさ} evokes nostalgia for the Showa era (1926-1989) and is experiencing a revival as young people seek out retro aesthetics.

FORMS:
⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧ (pure) + ⟦{喫茶|きっさ}→喫茶：28984_kissa⟧ (tea-drinking, coffee shop)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純喫茶|じゅんきっさ}⟦ブーム→ブーム：05511_buumu⟧: traditional coffee shop boom
- {純喫茶|じゅんきっさ}{巡|めぐ}り: visiting traditional coffee shops
- ⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{純喫茶|じゅんきっさ}: an old-fashioned traditional coffee shop
- {純喫茶|じゅんきっさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: the atmosphere of a traditional coffee shop

CULTURAL NOTE:
Typical features include dark wood interiors, velvet seats, classical music, hand-dripped coffee, and cream soda or Neapolitan spaghetti on the menu. They represent a disappearing slice of Showa-era Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
